description: Several small plastic bowls in different blue shades sit stacked on a dark blue bedspread in front of a pale pillow. The right hand reaches in from the right to lift the top bowl off the stack and sets it down to the right, while the left hand steadies the remaining stack; then the left hand lifts another bowl away to the left and the right hand separates and places another bowl forward, leaving the bowls unstacked and spread out.
